name: US online TRT clinic prices
description: Every cash price TRTcompare.co reads at US online testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) clinics: testosterone injections, cream and oral capsules, enclomiphene, clomiphene, hCG and anastrozole, one row per clinic and product, each in the clinic's own words with the plan it commits to, whether a membership is billed apart, whether it is compounded, the date it was read and the clinic's page it was read on.
attribution: TRTcompare.co, US online TRT clinic prices, https://trtcompare.co/data

columns.name: quote_id
columns.description: Stable identifier for the quote (clinic and product).

columns.name: clinic
columns.description: The online clinic that sells it.

columns.name: product
columns.description: The product as the clinic offers it, e.g. "Testosterone cypionate injections via Taurus Meds".

columns.name: medicine
columns.description: Testosterone, Enclomiphene, Clomiphene, hCG or Anastrozole.

columns.name: form
columns.description: injection, topical (cream or gel), capsule or tablet, when stated.

columns.name: compounded
columns.description: yes where the clinic says the product is compounded (every enclomiphene is). Compounded medicines are not FDA-approved.

columns.name: fda_approved
columns.description: yes where the clinic's page says FDA-approved or commercially made, or names an approved brand; no for compounded products and enclomiphene; not stated otherwise.

columns.name: price_kind
columns.description: What the price buys: the medicine, the medicine with care and labs, or a care plan alone with the medicine billed apart.

columns.name: membership_fee
columns.description: none when the clinic's page says no membership is charged beside the price; separate when one is; not stated otherwise.

columns.name: advertised_price
columns.description: The price as the clinic publishes it, e.g. "$149/mo" or "from $28/mo + membership".

columns.name: price_usd
columns.description: The advertised amount in US dollars (a month's price unless plan_months says otherwise). Empty when the clinic publishes no amount.

columns.name: plan_months
columns.description: Months the price commits to (1 = month to month), when stated.

columns.name: price_terms
columns.description: The clinic's own words the price was read from, quoted.

columns.name: checked_on
columns.description: The day (UTC) this price was last read on its source page (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: review_status
columns.description: current within 21 days of checked_on; overdue after that, when the quote is kept only as a dated reference.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: The clinic's page the price was read on.

columns.name: referral_program
columns.description: yes when TRTcompare.co may earn a referral fee from this clinic. It never changes a price order or a cheapest list.

columns.name: trtcompare_page
columns.description: The clinic's page on TRTcompare.co, with every price in context.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Conditions, fees and caveats from the clinic's terms.

quotes.notes: A $49 first step covers the testosterone test and the physician's review. The page shows $149 a month struck from $299 and does not say how long that price lasts. Cancellation is open any time up to 72 hours ahead of a billing date, and shipping is free in 2 days.

quotes.product: Testosterone cypionate injections via Tonik Wellness
quotes.price_terms: "Monthly $129 per month Month-to-month access"; 3 months "$92 per month, $276 billed every 3 months"; 12 months "$85 per month, $1,020 billed yearly"; "INCLUDES Testosterone, Injection supplies, Provider oversight, Concierge support, Secure patient portal"
quotes.notes: Its page does not state what labs cost. Optional memberships (Core Health $1,069 a year, Elite Optimization $1,350 a year) are sold apart.

quotes.price_terms: "Testosterone ... $99.99/mo"; "*2.5 months minimum purchase *California pricing may vary"; FAQ: "All medications prescribed through TRT Nation are sourced from licensed U.S. compounding pharmacies."

Labs are extra: its TRT bloodwork panel is $129, or bring your own. California pricing may vary.

TRT Nation's FAQ says its medications are from licensed US compounding pharmacies, and its policy page says refills are ordered by the patient ("Nation Medical will NOT automatically refill prescriptions"). Labs are extra: its TRT bloodwork panel is $129, or bring your own. California pricing may vary.

quotes.product: Testosterone injections via TRTBOSS
quotes.price_terms: its comparison table: "$149/month FSA / HSA Eligible", "Membership Fee: None", "Medications Included", "Supplies Included", labs "Extra", "Initial Lab work + Consult $149"; its header says "Starting at $99 a month"

quotes.product: Testosterone injections via Tuyo Health
quotes.price_terms: "monthly $179/mo $179 billed every month"; "3 months $139/mo" ($417 billed every 3 months); "6 months $129/mo" ($774 every 6 months); "12 months $99/mo" ($1,188 billed annually); "Every plan includes your prescription, a medical consult, and fast, discreet treatment delivery."
quotes.notes: The same plans cover injectable testosterone or oral enclomiphene; the page says either may be compounded. Labs are charged apart: first labs and a doctor visit at $99 for a limited time (listed at $170), then $99 every 3 months.

quotes.product: Testosterone cypionate injections (home delivery) via Vyta
quotes.price_terms: "$109/mo all-in. Everything handled and shipped to your door. Nothing to pay at a pharmacy."; "Both plans include your labs, physician visits, secure messaging, and dose management."; pharmacy pickup plan "$89/mo to Vyta plus about $35/mo at your pharmacy, about $124/mo all-in."
quotes.notes: Only in Florida, Michigan and Ohio, per its page. Labs and physician visits included.

quotes.product: Core care plan (labs and consults) via Ways2Well
quotes.price_terms: "Our ongoing Core plan is $125/month or $1,499/year and includes expanded testing, four provider consultations, ongoing guidance, and additional member benefits."; its page says "a prescription is not guaranteed or included"
quotes.notes: Labs and consults only: medication is billed apart, and the monthly Core plan needs at least two billing cycles. Its page says testosterone is unavailable in AL, AR, CT, GA, ID, MI, NH, OK, PA, SC, WV, LA and ND.

quotes.product: Compounded testosterone cypionate (3-month supply) via Yes Clinic
quotes.price_terms: "3 Months ($110 per month) $329"; "Includes medication, physician consultation, supplies, and shipping."; "No membership fees and no hidden fees"
quotes.notes: Sold as a 3-month supply. Labs: upload bloodwork from the last 6 months, or the provider arranges it; its page says a live video visit is required for TRT.

first_year.name: What a first year of TRT costs at US online clinics
first_year.description: Each US online TRT clinic's first year of testosterone, all in: twelve months of its cheapest month-to-month testosterone, plus the membership it requires, the first labs, the later lab panels its page prices within the year and its fixed fees, each part from the clinic's own page, with what the page leaves unpriced named, and the clinic's public record (Trustpilot, BBB, FDA warning letters).
